updates.title: CVE-2026-96940: Exchange Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A weak authorization flaw in Microsoft Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to elevate privileges over the network. Admins should apply patches immediately to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation in on-premises Exchange environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: View-Only Role Management Enhancements
updates.summary: A new view-only role management capability has been added to Purview and Defender portals, enabling security admins to audit all member assignments without granting modification permissions. This permission set will be added to existing Global Reader and Security Reader roles in both Purview and Entra.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Admin Assignment Time Limit
updates.summary: Purview now allows admins to set expiration dates (in days) when assigning users and security groups to role groups, enabling temporary access delegation without manual revocation. This addresses compliance and least-privilege requirements for time-bound admin permissions.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra ID: Passkey Support for B2B Users
updates.summary: B2B users can now register and use passkeys issued by resource tenants to satisfy MFA requirements, extending passkey support beyond member users in their home tenant. This roadmap feature, enabled by default, enhances authentication security for guest and external user scenarios.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management for Departed Employees
updates.summary: Purview's new data lifecycle management feature automates deletion of inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees at scale, reducing manual compliance effort. This capability ensures tenant compliance without requiring per-user remediation workflows.

updates.title: Purview DLP: Global Availability for Entra Global Secure Access Integration
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to enforce DLP policies and detect risky activity at the network layer for text, files, and AI interactions across browsers, apps, APIs, and SaaS platforms. This prevents sensitive data exfiltration to untrusted cloud and social media applications.

updates.title: Purview Information Barriers: Compliance Report Feature
updates.summary: A new compliance report capability for Information Barriers policies identifies SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and user-owned SharePoint Embedded containers that fall out of compliance after policy changes. This helps admins audit and remediate policy violations efficiently.
